name: nd-transfer-pricing
description: Use when a corporate group with North Dakota nexus needs the 2026 answer on ND connected-party and unitary rules: combined reporting for unitary businesses under N.D.C.C. § 57-38.1-19 (Joyce/Finnigan allocation questions), the water's-edge election with its 3.5% additional tax under § 57-38.4-02(3), the equally weighted three-factor formula with single-sales-factor election, and alternative apportionment under § 57-38.1-18 -- against the graduated 1.41%/3.55%/4.31% corporate brackets. Trigger on North Dakota combined return, ND unitary, water's edge surtax, 57-38.1-19, 57-38.4-02, Schedule SA, ND addback. Source-cited draft; ndlegis.nd.gov unreachable 2026-10-25, statute text carried from the existing nd-corporate-tax skill with VERIFY flags.
